sn52.4:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam āyasmā Anuruddho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca Mahā-Moggalāno Sākete viharanti Kaṇṭakīvane || || 2.
sn52.4:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā ca Sāriputto āyasmā ca MahāMoggalāno sāyaṇhasamayam paṭisallāṇā vuṭṭhitā yenāyasmā Anuruddho tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Anuruddhena saddiṃ sammodiṃsu ||
sn52.4:1.3: sammodanīyaṃ katham sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekam antaṃ nisīdiṃsu || || 3. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Sāriputto āyasmantam Anuruddham etad avoca || ||
sn52.4:1.4: Sekhenāvuso Anuruddha bhikkhunā katame dhammā upasampajja vihātabbā ti || ||
sn52.4:2.1: Sekhenāvuso Sariputta bhikkhunā cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā ||
sn52.4:2.3: Idhāvuso bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharati ātāpī sampājāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn52.4:2.6: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharati || ātāpī || sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn52.4:2.7: Sekhenāvuso Sāriputta ime cattāro satipaṭṭhānā upasampajja vihātabbā ti || || 1--2. Sākete nidānaṃ ||
